test: Use the original eight exposed development donors for choosing one checkpoint by event-level improvement from the same W-tap state. Then collect eight new native mirror donors after freezing the winner and play separate 20s native scenarios under the same W-tap acquisition, 2s active defender delay, 20 CPS, MMC, 3-block reach, both seats and 0/80ms. Compare W-tap, original specialist and distilled finalist, six independent draws per seat/RTT for each arm. Score first K3, sensitivity K5 and K10, both return definitions, full denominator and duration. The native finalist is a standard 22-by-8-by-5 MLP, with no future event or oracle call in the playing path.
